This card also owns the dimension half of the up-front refusal. When a driver lacks the join capability (MongoDB, OData; memory excepted), an analytics **dimension** through a lookup should answer the same stable 400 that this card builds for a cross-object where. #33664 (p1) fixes only the SQL 500 and leaves the non-SQL FK-expand serving as it does today. Seat route recorded on #33664. Build both refusals from the one capability bit, so where and dimension are decided once (ADR-0139 amendment).
